_comment: What the streamlinedai.tech SEO agent checks each run. Updated 18 Nov 2026 (PM brief seo-trade-pages-1118): worldwide wording, prices by country, fifteen indexable routes, and the agent opens pull requests only and NEVER merges one. Owned by the Atlas & Website Product Manager; edits go through the Build Manager. The site is a Vite SPA on Vercel with PRERENDERED per-route meta: client/src/lib/seo-routes.ts is the single source of truth; vite-plugin-prerender-meta.ts writes every page once per market into dist/public/_m/<market>/ with that market's prices in the HTML (client/src/lib/pricing.ts); vercel.json sends each request to its market by Vercel's country header, and its rewrites are generated by script/market-rewrites.ts, never edited by hand; client/public/sitemap.xml lists the indexable routes. Removed routes (/business, /galway, /contractors, /installers, /australia, /mining, /au, /ai-training, the set-up-AI guide, /ai-employees/*, /details, /details/thanks) are 301s to / in vercel.json and have no page, ROUTE_SEO entry, mirror or sitemap entry; /products 301s to /our-work. Never re-add them. Adding a route needs Pete first, then seo-routes.ts, the page, App.tsx, vercel.json (regenerated), the sitemap, a mirror and this file; the route-wiring check exists to catch a missed one.

site._gsc_note: URL-prefix property (not sc-domain). Owner streamlinedtechai@gmail.com, verified by the meta tag in client/index.html. The OAuth refresh token used by the AutoListing agent already has siteOwner access to this property (verified 21 Aug 2026), so the same GSC_* env vars are used. A Domain property (sc-domain:streamlinedai.tech) was added on 17 Nov 2026 but holds almost no history; keep the URL-prefix property for the numbers.
site._aliases_note: Empty on purpose. /galway is a 301 to / in vercel.json and stays that way.

_pr_scopes_comment: Concentric PR scopes. Each scope = its own branch and PR, never bundled. Mechanical = blind autofix (sitemap, robots). Metadata = field-level edits in seo-routes.ts that do not change meaning. Perf = image/resource hints. Content = title/description rewrites backed by GSC evidence. Anything else goes in the issue.

metadata_pr_allowed_changes: Trim a description over 160 characters to 160 or fewer, keeping its meaning and every fact
Replace an em dash or en dash in a title or description with a comma, full stop or the word 'for', rewording if needed so the sentence still reads plainly
Add a missing optional field to an existing ROUTE_SEO entry (image for a route that has a 1200x630 card in client/public/images; noindex for a route the issue history says must stay out of results)
Correct a canonical that points at a path not in ROUTE_SEO
metadata_pr_forbidden: Change what a title or description says (that is content_pr scope and needs GSC evidence)
Add or remove a route entry or touch PRERENDER_ROUTES (a new route needs vercel.json and App.tsx changes too; raise it in the issue)
Touch vercel.json, client/index.html, vite-plugin-prerender-meta.ts, App.tsx, any page file, server/, api/, shared/, or any .env file
Alter the founder wording, prices (the two From prices, per market, live only in client/src/lib/pricing.ts), or any tagline
perf_pr_allowed_changes: Add loading="lazy" and decoding="async" to elements that are below the fold (never the hero or the LCP candidate)
Add explicit width and height attributes to elements that lack them
Add a <link rel="preload" as="image"> for an LCP candidate that has none (check whether home already preloads its hero before adding one)
Add fetchpriority="high" to an LCP candidate
perf_pr_forbidden: Change an image src, swap formats, or reference a file that is not committed
Remove existing preload or fetchpriority hints
Any layout, class, copy or component change
content_pr_allowed_changes: Rewrite one route's title (max 65 chars, must contain 'Streamlined Tech') to target a striking-distance query from GSC (position 4-20, at least 10 impressions in the lookback window)
Rewrite that route's description (50-160 chars) for the same query
pr_scopes.content_pr_required_evidence: The PR body names the GSC query, its current position and impressions, the route, and shows before/after. The new copy must pass every rule in copy_rules. One content PR per run at most.
content_pr_forbidden: Any rewrite without GSC striking-distance evidence (speculative rewrites go in the issue as suggestions)
Touching H1s, hero copy, body copy, CTAs, navigation or footer
A title or description that breaks a copy rule
Adding a phone number, a demo link, a link to a client's website, a price other than the two in client/src/lib/pricing.ts, or any call button
pr_scopes._merge_rule: The agent opens pull requests only. It never merges a pull request, not even its own (Pete's rule for this agent, 18 Nov 2026). Pete or the Build Manager merges.

new_trade_page_pr.title: DO NOT MERGE: SEO page proposal: <trade> (awaiting Pete)
allowed_only_when: the trade is listed as built or approved in config/trades-built.json
the trade has no page yet
the PR body gives the evidence from Search Console, or a WebSearch spot check clearly labelled 'US-weighted'
a facts file approved by Pete exists for that trade; if none exists, open an issue asking for the facts instead of a PR
new_trade_page_pr.how: Build the page from the same template, rules and allowed-facts approach as the 18 Nov 2026 trade pages (client/src/pages/pest-control-app.tsx and client/src/components/trade-sections.tsx): one H1 equal to the title minus the brand, about 500 plain words, existing sample screens only, prices only from client/src/lib/pricing.ts, one call button (the page-end ClosingCall), all six files wired. Never merged by the agent.

trade_page_improvement_pr.title: DO NOT MERGE: SEO page improvement: <route> (awaiting Pete)
allowed_changes: a visible FAQ question or answer (and its matching structured data)
trade_page_improvement_pr.required_evidence: The Search Console numbers quoted in the PR body. Never bundled with a mechanical, metadata, perf or content PR.

never: Generate town, country or sector pages from a template
Build links, press releases, directory submissions, guest posts or forum posts
Touch the Google Business Profile or any directory listing
Write a client name other than IPM Enviro and Komplete Engineers
Make any claim that is not on the site

copy_rules._comment: Pete's voice rules, enforced by checks/copy-rules.mjs on live titles/descriptions and on page source text. Violations are reported; the agent may only fix dashes in seo-routes.ts (metadata scope). Pattern names starting removed_ or banned_ are hard bans from the 17 Nov 2026 rewrite: any hit is a warning to raise in the issue, never something to work around. Since 18 Nov 2026 the site is written for the UK, US, Australia and Ireland in British spelling: no Irish-only wording and no 'ring' (use 'call').

banned_patterns.name: multiplier_claim
banned_patterns.why: hard promise figure (Pete: no 10x in print)

banned_patterns.name: percent_claim
banned_patterns.why: check it is a public fact, not a promise

banned_patterns.name: ai_tell_word
banned_patterns.why: reads as AI-written in Pete's voice

banned_patterns.name: set_up_hyphenated_verb
banned_patterns.why: verb form is two words: set up

banned_patterns.name: phone_number
banned_patterns.why: no phone number or tel: link anywhere on the site (17 Nov 2026 rewrite)

banned_patterns.name: demo_link
banned_patterns.why: no public demo link or 'try a demo' link on the site (17 Nov 2026 rewrite). The only demo pictures allowed are the static sample screens in /images/screens, with every name replaced (Pete, 17 Nov 2026)

banned_patterns.name: ai_employees
banned_patterns.why: AI Employees was removed entirely (17 Nov 2026); never re-add it

banned_patterns.name: set_up_with_ai_positioning
banned_patterns.why: old 'We set your business up with AI' positioning was removed (17 Nov 2026)

banned_patterns.name: ai_hype_word
banned_patterns.why: avoided words on this site (PM brief, 18 Nov 2026)

banned_patterns.name: ring_for_call
banned_patterns.why: 'ring' is not said in the US; the marketing pages say 'call' (18 Nov 2026). /privacy and /terms still say 'ring' in their approved legal wording: that is expected there and out of scope, so read where the hit is before raising it.

banned_patterns.name: irish_only_wording
banned_patterns.why: the marketing pages are worldwide since 18 Nov 2026, with no Irish-only wording. /privacy and /terms still say 'custom apps for Irish trade and service businesses' in their approved legal wording (reported to Pete on 18 Nov 2026, his call): expected there, so read where the hit is before raising it.

banned_patterns.name: compliance_claim
banned_patterns.why: no compliance or accreditation claim anywhere (PM brief, 18 Nov 2026)

copy_rules._founder_note: The old founder_claim check ('over 20 years in heavy industry and construction') was dropped on 18 Nov 2026: round 2 (PR 69) replaced that wording with 'Founder, Streamlined Tech' and a line that gives no number of years. checks/copy-rules.mjs skips the check when this key is absent.

_pre_pr_smoke_checks_comment: This repo has no CI, so these are the only gates. 'npm run check' is tsc; 'npx vite build' runs the client build including the prerender plugin, which is what turns seo-routes.ts into the live HTML heads. Install with npm ci first.

serp_spot_check._comment: Optional, via the WebSearch tool only (Google blocks scripted fetches and the agent never works around a bot check). WebSearch is US-weighted, so label results 'WebSearch, US-weighted'. Cap at max_queries per run, entry queries first.

indexnow._comment: Public verification key, not a secret. Bing/Yandex/Naver fetch https://streamlinedai.tech/<key>.txt to verify. Submit only URLs a PR actually added.

link_check._comment: Hosts that answer non-browser clients with 4xx/999 regardless of the page's health. A non-2xx from these is reported as likely_bot_block, not broken.

trade_page_rules._comment: Enforced by checks/trade-pages.mjs, which reads the repo and, when a build exists, dist/public. The testimonial text is held here so the check needs no private file; the source of truth is the Product Manager's testimonial files (streamlined-bot-files atlas-website/testimonials/), and only Pete changes these words.
trade_page_rules._client_website_hosts_note: Any link to a client's website is banned. The check fails on ANY external link in a trade page's or the hub's main content, so this short list is a second net, not the rule. Add a host here only when it is known for certain.

/pest-control-app.text: We were working with another company for 12 months and weren't even close to launch. Pete contacted us by email, we had a chat, and almost overnight we had a product sample to look at. Our client is a multinational pharmaceutical plant and they're very pleased with how professional it looks, but the most important thing is how user friendly it is. There's literally no training required for our techs or their people.

/engineering-firm-software.text: It's made our process much more efficient, in speed and in knowing when invoices are due. Overall it's greatly benefited the efficiency of the business. We're definitely managing the work better and getting things done quicker.
